propositions: A plan edited mid-review currently wastes all remaining LLM passes and only fails at sign time when generation.sign_manifest detects own_material mismatch
Cancel signals must be scoped to own material only (not relation snapshot or related material) to avoid reintroducing bug d70a false cancellations on unrelated ticket writes

The cancel mechanism must be an out-of-band token checked before coach/verify recovery paths to prevent cancelled runs from being recovered into findings verdicts that flow to signing and sidecar emission
Cancel probes at the two pass seams (after finders and after decide) should perform only lightweight single-ticket reads under local_read_context without fetching or acquiring sync locks
A mid-run own-material change produces an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with plan-review-cancelled-stale finding and exits with code 2, skipping all floors, signing, and sidecar writes
